evals.name: working-tree-with-plan-in-context
evals.prompt: Profile: acme (Reviewers: claude, codex; Default branch main). The approved plan is in context and its Closing steps read "verify → review (judgment tier × 2) → hand off to the PR capability". The implementation is done and uncommitted. Run the review.
evals.expected_output: Targets the uncommitted diff, reads judgment × 2 from the plan's review line, launches a Claude subagent on Opus and codex on Astra in one parallel message, both read-only in the shared tree, then triages into one report.
assertions: Target is the working tree, named with its diff command, not a branch range
Tier and count come from the plan's Closing steps review line, not from a question to the user
Two reviewers launched in one message: a claude subagent at Opus and codex at the judgment-tier model
Codex invoked as `codex exec --sandbox read-only` with stdin from /dev/null
No worktree created and no file edited
One report: severity counts, findings P1 down with file:line and a fix, ruled-out list, per-reviewer counts

evals.name: pr-target-without-a-plan
evals.prompt: Profile: acme (Reviewers: claude, codex). Review PR 4821 for bugs. No plan file exists for this work.
evals.expected_output: Reads the PR diff through gh, falls back to one judgment-tier reviewer because neither a plan nor the caller supplied tier and count, and reports the fallback it applied.
assertions: PR read through `gh pr diff` / `gh pr view` rather than a checkout, unless a checkout is needed and then only after asking
Falls back to one reviewer at the judgment tier and states that fallback
The first Reviewers entry is the one that runs
No fix applied to the PR branch

evals.name: plan-file-target-contract-gaps
evals.prompt: Profile: acme (Reviewers: claude, codex; Commit policy: direct commits to main). Review ~/.claude/plans/new-cache-layer.md before I approve it — it has no Verification heading and its Steps mention two files that Approach + Files never lists.
evals.expected_output: Reviews the plan text against the ten-heading contract, returns the missing Verification heading and the two unlisted files as ranked findings, and applies no edit to the plan.
assertions: Target kind is a plan file and reviewers read the plan text, not a code diff
Findings check the ten headings in order and flag the missing Verification section
Steps naming files absent from Approach + Files reported as a contradiction
Findings ranked P1-P3 and quote headings instead of file:line
The plan file is not edited or completed by this skill

evals.name: single-installed-reviewer-under-count-two
evals.prompt: Profile: a fixture org template whose Reviewers row reads `claude` only. The plan's review line reads "judgment tier × 2". Review the working tree.
evals.expected_output: Runs the one installed reviewer, and the report states that a count of 2 yielded one reviewer because the Reviewers row lists only claude.
assertions: Exactly one reviewer runs; codex is not invoked
The shortfall is stated explicitly in the report — count 2 requested, one installed
No reviewer is invented beyond the Reviewers row
The review still completes with a full triaged report

evals.name: codex-stdin-and-tier-mapping
evals.prompt: Profile: acme. Review this branch against main with codex at the fast tier.
evals.expected_output: Runs the branch range against main, maps the fast tier to the codex Luna model, and invokes codex read-only with stdin redirected from /dev/null so the call cannot hang.
assertions: Branch range computed from `git merge-base` against the profile's Default branch
Tier and reviewer taken from the caller's words, no plan consulted
`< /dev/null` present on the codex invocation
Model codename mapped from the tiers table, and the actual reviewing model recorded if codex rejects the codename

evals.name: no-repo-review-skill-picked
evals.prompt: Profile: acme, in a repo that ships its own review skill. Review my uncommitted changes for bugs with independent reviewers.
evals.expected_output: Runs the reviewers from the Reviewers row only, leaving any repo-side review skill to the plan that names it.
assertions: Reviewers come from the profile's Reviewers row
No repo-based review skill invoked or recommended as part of this run
Report notes nothing was fixed
